title: Missing Row-Level Lock on Mutable Balance
description: Function 'withdraw' reads account balance without with_for_update(). Vulnerable to concurrent race-condition overdrafts.

title: Missing Row-Level Lock on Mutable Balance
description: Function 'transfer' reads account balance without with_for_update(). Vulnerable to concurrent race-condition overdrafts.

title: Non-Atomic Dual-Commit Ledger Operation
description: Function 'transfer' commits transactions 2 times. Partial failures will leave ledger in an inconsistent state.
suggested_fix: Consolidate all ledger stage updates into a single atomic commit or context manager transaction.

title: Float Precision in Ledger Balance
description: Column 'balance' uses Float instead of Decimal or integer cents, leading to IEEE-754 rounding drift.
